title: Claude Fable 5.1 / medium effort
description: A white pelican with large cartoon eyes, a pale-yellow beak and cream throat pouch, and long white wings reaching to the handlebar, with tan legs on the pedals, riding a coral-red bicycle with dark tires and silver spokes over a pale gray checkered floor in soft haze; the cast shadow is clipped by a circular edge in some views.

unmetRequirements.evidence: The ground shadow ends in a hard circular cut instead of following the rider's silhouette: in level-04 the shadow of the pelican's head and beak is sliced off at the right, and in level-06 the shadow is cut by an arc at the lower left. The fragment shader computes shadows only where length(p-BC)<3.4 (line 111), so the shadow stops at that sphere.
